Our analysis

Of the 33 large SUVs in our comparison, the Ford Ranger 2.0 EcoBlue is the 15th cheapest to own.

Its biggest cost is depreciation: €24,882 over 5 years, 58% of the total.

At a real consumption of 8.0 L/100 km, every 100 km costs about €15.18 in fuel.

FAQ

How much does a Ford Ranger 2.0 EcoBlue cost per month?

About €720 a month at 15,000 km a year over 5 years, including depreciation, energy, insurance, servicing and road tax. That's €0.576 per km.

Which DGT label does the Ford Ranger 2.0 EcoBlue have?

The C label.
